description: Defines the LayerProtoParser class and related nested classes for parsing and representing layer proto data structures in the Android surfaceflinger component.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser
classes.description: Parser class for layer proto data structures, providing methods to generate and convert layer trees and individual layer components.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::ActiveBuffer
classes.description: Represents an active buffer with dimensions and format.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::Rect
classes.description: Defines a rectangle with integer coordinates.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::FloatRect
classes.description: Defines a rectangle with float coordinates.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::Region
classes.description: Represents a region composed of multiple rectangles.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::Layer
classes.description: Represents a layer with properties such as position, size, regions, and children.

classes.name: LayerProtoParser::LayerTree
classes.description: Contains a collection of all layers and top-level layer pointers.

methods.name: generateLayerTree
methods.description: Generates a layer tree from a LayersProto object.

methods.name: layerTreeToString
methods.description: Converts a LayerTree to its string representation.

methods.name: generateLayerList
methods.description: Generates a list of layers from LayersProto.

methods.name: generateLayer
methods.description: Creates a Layer object from a LayerProto.

methods.name: generateRegion
methods.description: Creates a Region object from a RegionProto.

methods.name: generateRect
methods.description: Creates a Rect object from a RectProto.

methods.name: generateFloatRect
methods.description: Creates a FloatRect object from a FloatRectProto.

methods.name: generateTransform
methods.description: Creates a Transform object from a TransformProto.

methods.name: generateActiveBuffer
methods.description: Creates an ActiveBuffer from an ActiveBufferProto.

methods.name: updateChildrenAndRelative
methods.description: Updates child and relative layer relationships based on layer proto data.

methods.name: layerToString
methods.description: Converts a Layer object to its string representation.
